# Switch — Verified Staffing Platform in Gurgaon

> Switch (switchlocally.com) is an on-demand staffing platform in Gurgaon, India, that helps businesses hire Aadhaar-verified, background-checked Switch Players — store helpers, security guards, factory and warehouse Switch Players, waiters, bartenders, cooks and housekeeping staff — for shops, restaurants, warehouses, offices and events. Switch also serves homes with verified cooks, cleaners, caretakers and drivers. Every Switch Player is Aadhaar-verified, rates are transparent and fixed up front with no hidden charges, and a replacement is guaranteed if a Switch Player is not a fit.

## Key facts

- **Name:** Switch

## What makes Switch different

- **Aadhaar-verified Switch Players:** Every Switch Player's government ID is verified before assignment.
- **Transparent billing:** One clear rate with no hidden charges or agency commission; every booking is invoiced. Monthly plans start at Rs 999/month (T&C apply).
- **Replacement guarantee:** If a Switch Player is not the right fit, Switch arranges a fast replacement.
- **Same-day & bulk hiring:** Single Switch Players or full teams; weekly (7-day) teams available.
- **Both business and home staffing on one platform.**

## Services for businesses

- Store and retail helpers
- Security guards and bouncers
- Factory and warehouse Switch Players
- Waiters, bartenders and event staff
- Cooks and kitchen helpers
- Housekeeping and office support
- Drivers (personal and corporate)

## Services for homes

- Home cleaning and housekeeping
- Cooks
- Elderly caretakers
- Babysitters / nannies
- Personal drivers

## Frequently asked

- **How fast can Switch provide a Switch Player?** Most bookings are confirmed the same day, often within a few hours.
- **How does payment work?** Monthly subscription plans are billed in advance for the plan period; hourly, daily and weekly bookings are invoiced against the hours worked. Rates are fixed up front with no hidden charges.
- **Are Switch Players verified?** Yes — every Switch Player is Aadhaar-verified and background-checked before assignment.
- **What if a Switch Player is not a good fit?** Switch provides a fast, no-questions-asked replacement.
